summary: A resident describes keeping devices long after the family stops using them.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). House supporters described households accumulating electronics they did not know how to dispose of.
inGame: needs: a resident has retained unused electronics.
gates: A resident has retained unused electronics.

turns.what: The family finds a collection site.
turns.pulledBy: A collection site accepts the devices.

turns.what: One of the stored laptops stays in use.
turns.pulledBy: One laptop can still be repaired.
turns.writesBack: The family sets that one aside.
